title: Kinetic typography reel (three.js and canvas)
what_it_does: Skill for portfolio and work reels with condensed display type, HUD micro-type and WebGL layers.
when_to_use: Showreels and intro films, not footage editing.
why: Generates the whole film in code and never edits footage; painted-animation in the same repo is cartoon animation. MIT, so another group can take it.
